About

Backend-focused, full-stack when the product needs it.

I am a software developer with 6+ years of professional experience designing, building, maintaining, and deploying production web applications and backend systems.

My strongest area is PHP and Laravel backend engineering: REST APIs, authentication and authorization, relational database architecture, payment integrations, asynchronous processing, Redis-based systems, queues, WebSockets, and third-party integrations.

I also work across Vue.js, Nuxt.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, which helps me connect backend architecture to user-facing interfaces and complete product workflows.
